_comment: Guest details for the episode pages. Consumed by tools/apply-guest-strip.py,
which stamps a guest block into each podcast/<slug>/index.html.
'linkedin' and 'bio' are the two fields that still need filling. The script
refuses to run while any are empty, so the guest block ships complete or not
at all. Names and roles are already correct and need no editing.
Bios are ONE sentence. The role line sits directly above, so a bio that just
restates the role is wasted - say what the role does not. Values are HTML:
use & for &, and ’ for an apostrophe.
Pre-filled bios were written from text already on the site. Blank ones are
guests the site says nothing about beyond their role.
